verification.runtime_check: Docker was not running. Docker Desktop engine unavailable and the Windows postgres service could not be started (no admin rights), so I initialised a throwaway Postgres 18 cluster in the scratchpad dir (initdb, port 5432), seeded the biyahe DB, ran pytest, and ran uvicorn from the working tree on :8765. HTTP checks were real. No real browser or headless browser tool was available. Front-end behavior (banners, parallel fetches, draw/no-draw, dedupe, coordinate swap, legend text) was exercised only through a node harness with stubbed Leaflet and DOM against live API responses. Visual rendering (colors on map, legend look, banner overlay position and z-order, popups on click, attribution appearance, panel layout, fit of the view, tiles loading) was NOT run and is not claimed verified; the owner must check these in a browser.
verification.self_critique: Not tested: real Leaflet rendering, browser CSS layout, popup click, tile loading, real network-panel parallelism. The stubbed harness trusts that Leaflet calls behave per their API. Test DB encoding issue was an artifact of my local cluster. Postgres version 18 here versus 16 in the project's Compose. The vendored leaflet.js was checked only by its header comment, not by hash against the official release. Local temp cluster and uvicorn were started by me and need stopping (cleanup attempted in the final step).
